outside_sources.title: Blender Manual — Curve to Mesh Node
outside_sources.author: Blender Documentation Team

expert_notes: GeometryNodeShortestEdgePaths is a field node with no Geometry input — evaluation context is set by EdgePathsToCurves.Mesh socket
Random per-edge cost via RandomValue(FLOAT, ID=InputIndex, Seed=COST_SEED) breaks geodesic symmetry; COST_MAX/COST_MIN ratio is the zigzag factor
EdgePathsToCurves traces FROM start vertices TOWARD nearest end vertex, following the Dijkstra next-hop tree built by ShortestEdgePaths
Two-stage start vertex selection: FunctionNodeCompare(LESS_THAN, START_EQ_Z) gates the equatorial band; RandomValue(BOOLEAN, Probability=START_PROB) thins to a controllable fraction
Empty base mesh + IcoSphere node inside GN = fully portable asset with no dependency on a pre-built mesh data block
export_apply=True is mandatory — Three.js and Babylon.js do not evaluate GN modifiers; the GLB must contain realised mesh data
Start Density group socket (Input_2 in modifier) drives RandomValue(BOOLEAN).Probability — animating 0 → 0.60 reveals traces progressively without touching the node graph
